reviews.title: New Game - Old Tale
reviews.text: I’ve been playing multi-play video poker for I believe years, but I think I will have to move on.  Somehow, the algorithms in your new app have changed the game for me.  I can’t seem to get any big hands and run out of credits so I have to buy in order to stay in the game.  I used to have to only pay $19.99 and now you’ve changed it to $49.99, a price I’m not happy to pay.  I work at this program daily; I’m even a subscriber at $19.99 a month and yet I can’t get a break…trips never turn to quads, two pair never turn to a full house, not to mention four card straights or flushes.  It’s been very discouraging over the last several weeks.  I guess I will play out the money I have and then cancel and delete.

reviews.title: Money vacuum…
reviews.text:
I play a lot of video poker at casinos… the app is a visually beautiful  representation of the machines at casinos, but that’s where the similarities end… I understand the developers desire to make money, but ridiculous is ridiculous… after 5+ years (including spending $20/month for chip buys) of playing very small bets on the app ( because it strongly appears the programming has been set to grind away at your bank) and way too frequently attempt to get you to buy more chips…

There is a weekly poker challenge in the game with 16 stages… I typically finish 1-13 in about 2 hours, then spend 5 days looking for (2) 4 of a kind to finish stage 14…

Not enough big wins, and the chip packages are too expensive

Also, no defined way to obtain any user level above “Bronze”…

And 2 MINUTE advertisements to get the same 5,000 chips that we got for 30 seconds, just 2 years ago…

My guess is that they keep me losing so I will eventually be forced to buy more coins. Not happening!

reviews.title: Money Pit
reviews.text: This game is a money pit.  Big wins are rare but necessary to maintain enough credits to play.  A vast majority of plays are losers and when a rare big win does occur the game clamps down and slowly milks your winnings away.  I played the app often for over two years and tried to find a game that would at least let me come close to breaking even and none would.  Be careful with this game - it is flashy and can even be fun but will always grind you down to nothing and then entice you to purchase more credits at an incredibly expensive price.
XXX
